author: [AEP] Bodhitree
content: IRL insurance is a bit scamy. They say they are providing "security" in case something bad happens and bad things do happen, but all of those risks are statistics calulated by actuaries. The insurance company bets the most peeople wont have accidents and they won't need to pay out on claims. They happily take your money and invest it into commercial real estate to make more money with your "deposits" and then it is one of the most difficult processes in the world to actually get a claim pay out. After you do file a claim and they do pay out, it is extremely difficult to get insurance elsewhere because you're now "high" risk for them. Not a big fan of insurance companies

author: 🅰🅲🅴🅺🅸🅽🅶MUD
content: I can give more context here.  First of all, it takes a LOT of resources to upgrade any starbase. And a variety of them. So even a gigantic mighty Uber whale won’t be able to do much by himself.  Second, there are 17 starbases in each faction, so you can choose to take care of one that don’t have many players trying to upgrade there.  Third, you can do small batches that get completed real quickly.  Fourth, you can also work on upkeeing the starbase, which also awards lp.  Fifth, you don’t need to play the lp game at all if you don’t think it is profitable, focusing on mining might be even more profitable depending on the context.  Sixth, it is easier for whales to get rekt than smaller players, because their enormous orders will take a long while to complete, while smaller players batches will probably go faster

author: [AEP] Moustacheride
content: So I was worried about this and the more I started thinking about this the more I think it actually may be really hard to manage a Titan in these early stages.  There is a cap on LP so they theoretically would be earning significantly less as a VWAP percentage than other players.  Also they have a HUGE resource demand to manage one of those ships so they will most likely need support from the marketplace to supply it with Fuel, Ammo and Food.  Plus since they can't corner the market in all resources at once there will always be a resource that players could focus on to supply the Starbase with.  So basically despite it seeming bad for Oni to have a Titan in terms of LP rewards it actually could be a benefit as it cold open up other markets for smaller players to just help keep that thing running..

author: [AEP] Moustacheride
content: Original GAO Ships “insurance”  The idea behind the offering the “lifetime insurance” is multi faceted and seems to be tackling several problems associated with HRZ and the game as a whole:  Increases value to GAO ship holders,Increases the activity in the HRZ,Create an atlas sink and provide a revenue source for the DAO,Create a crafting loop for non PVPers,Lowers the financial barrier for new players, The idea is that there will be 2 tiers of ships- GAO and Crafted. The GAO ships cannot be permanently destroyed, but would require payment to access your ship if destroyed in HRZ. That payment would be scale by how fast you would like to regain access to your ship.  For example: GAO ship destroyed,Respawn timer without insurance: 1-6 months,Respawn timer with insurance: 24hour- 2 weeks (pricing scales with shorter timers) (expedited respawns also limited per quarter or per year), The crafted ships will not be eligible for insurance and if they are destroyed in HRZ, they are burned. These ships would also be much cheaper, allowing new players to come into the space and contribute to the ecosystem effectively without needing to drop $1000’s.   The goal with the new players is to push them to strive towards GAO assets to drive demand  Anything to add? @SW4GN3R

content: This is actually something that's going on now. I've only loosely mentioned. I've gained more comfort in facilitating lending within Portal, though we still did not/do not have the resources to prioritize it ourselves. Nevertheless, the roadmap may or may not cover all externalities and potential feature sets that can be built within the ecosystem layer, as it is primarily focused on gameplay features. However, I'll chat with Dom when we get some more clarity about feasibility and add it to the roadmap if/when appropriate.  Perhaps my best non-answer ever.

author: 𝐑𝐎𝐌𝐄 | Virtuwul [ROME]
content: It's very easy for the person behind the bot to spin up new wallets instantly. It's whack o' mole.,Despite the frustration you all encounter, MM bots are in fact good for the market by providing buy and sell liquidity, My honest take is that people aren't actually angry about bots themselves. They're upset about the fact that they aren't able to place an order as low as they had hoped. Ignoring the necessity to make several transactions if you're attempting to outbid the bot, there is a point beyond which the bot will not bid. That makes you the best bidder, unless of course someone else comes in and outbids you.  I'd love to offer everyone the capability to automate trading. And I think it could be as simple as adding 3 parameters into the market, and leveraging a Profile integration:  Bid/Ask (already exists),Best Bid/Ask (your highest buying / lowest selling price),Tick Size (Parameter for which you want to place a new bid after being outbid - understanding that you will pay tx fees if you use a smaller tick size), If/when that rolls out, you're able to plug in the absolute best price you're willing to buy or sell at, and let the marketplace do the rest.

author: 《VΛ》ValPhoenix [STAR]
content: We are all here for the same goal, which is the success of Star Atlas, so we must try to put ourselves in both positions and try to understand point of views (and duties). From team's point of view, to have an OFFICIAL (this is a key point) channel where otc trades are possible, is counter productive. Not for the fees, that also exists as a possible problem but i'm not sure how relevant,  but because if something bad happens, as it seems it happened, they got involved with some requests of help for something they don't want to be involved, and they're not responsible for. So, the only solution to this problem is to avoid their responsability from the channel once for all. I'm one of the most active persons on the channel, but here no one (I think) is warning us to not do anything otc, just not in an official channel. Just move somewhere else. With that said, I admit that i don't do otc to avoid fees, they're not a problem, but just because mp is not working smoothly, an overall improve of the mp could make people meet halfway maybe. Mp problems are well known, bot is not considered a problem by many, I personally would say it is. Then several bugs, low liquidity.

author: ! SH | Bohemian ⪛⦿⫺
content: It's basically wallet agnostic auto-sign where you can set which instructions are allowed to be auto-sign. The app will dynamically determine which wallet to use (hot wallet we generate or your real wallet) for each transaction. For example if you think crafting should require your ledger to sign but movement shouldn't you can set the hot wallet to do movement and not crafting. Then while you're playing the game movement requires no sign dialog but when you click to craft it will require your ledger.

The app will dynamically determine which wallet to use (hot wallet we generate or your real wallet) for each transaction. For example if you think crafting should require your ledger to sign but movement shouldn't you can set the hot wallet to do movement and not crafting. Then while you're playing the game movement requires no sign dialog but when you click to craft it will require your ledger.
